criteria.text: TMS must be prescribed and administered by a licensed physician knowledgeable in the use of rTMS.
criteria.source_quote: TMS may be covered if prescribed and administered by a licensed physician who is knowledgeable in the use of repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation.
criteria.if_missing: Is TMS prescribed and administered by a licensed physician knowledgeable in rTMS?

criteria.text: Patient must be an adult with a confirmed diagnosis of severe major depressive disorder, single or recurrent episode.
criteria.source_quote: an adult who has a confirmed diagnosis of severe major depressive disorder (MDD) single or recurrent episode
criteria.if_missing: Is there a confirmed diagnosis of severe MDD (single or recurrent episode) in an adult patient?

criteria.text: Patient must have failed to benefit from initial treatment of depression.
criteria.source_quote: Outpatient rTMS may be indicated for patients with DSM-IV defined Major Depressive Disorder who have failed to benefit from initial treatment of their depression.
criteria.if_missing: Has the patient failed to benefit from initial treatment of their depression?
criteria.short: No documented failure of initial treatment

criteria.text: Resistance to treatment: lack of clinically significant response to a trial of psychopharmacologic agents from at least 2 different agent classes in current episode, each at adequate dose/duration.
criteria.source_quote: Resistance to treatment with psychopharmacologic agents as evidenced by a lack of a clinically significant response to 1 trial of psychopharmacologic agents in the current depressive episode from at least 2 different agent classes.
criteria.if_missing: Does the patient meet the medication resistance criterion (failed trial with at least 2 agent classes at adequate dosing in current episode)?

criteria.text: Inability to tolerate psychopharmacologic agents: 2 trials from at least 2 different agent classes with distinct side effects.
criteria.source_quote: Inability to tolerate psychopharmacologic agents as evidenced by 2 trials of psychopharmacologic agents from at least 2 different agent classes, with distinct side effects
criteria.if_missing: Does the patient meet the medication intolerance criterion (2 trials, 2+ classes, distinct side effects)?

criteria.text: History of response to rTMS in a previous depressive episode.
criteria.source_quote: History of response to rTMS in a previous depressive episode
criteria.if_missing: Does the patient have a history of response to rTMS in a previous depressive episode?

criteria.text: Patient is currently receiving ECT, with rTMS considered as a less invasive alternative.
criteria.source_quote: If patient is currently receiving electro-convulsive therapy, rTMS may be considered reasonable and necessary as a less invasive treatment option.
criteria.if_missing: Is the patient currently receiving ECT?

criteria.text: At least one of the four sub-criteria (med resistance, med intolerance, prior rTMS response, current ECT) must be met.
criteria.source_quote: One or more of the following:
criteria.if_missing: Does the patient meet at least one of the four listed sub-criteria (medication resistance, intolerance, prior rTMS response, or current ECT)?
criteria.short: None of the required sub-criteria met

criteria.text: Patient must have had a trial of evidence-based psychotherapy effective for MDD, of adequate frequency and duration, without significant improvement as documented by standardized rating scales.
criteria.source_quote: A trial of an evidence-based psychotherapy known to be effective in the treatment of MDD of an adequate frequency and duration without significant improvement in depressive symptoms as documented by standardized rating scales that reliably measure depressive symptoms.
criteria.if_missing: Has the patient had a documented trial of evidence-based psychotherapy of adequate frequency/duration without significant improvement, per standardized rating scales?
criteria.short: No documented adequate psychotherapy trial failure

criteria.text: The order for treatment (or retreatment) must be written by a psychiatrist (MD or DO) who has examined the patient and reviewed the record.
criteria.source_quote: The order for treatment (or retreatment) is written by a psychiatrist (MD or DO) who has examined the patient and reviewed the record.
criteria.if_missing: Was the treatment order written by a psychiatrist (MD/DO) who examined the patient and reviewed the record?
criteria.short: Order not written by qualifying psychiatrist

criteria.text: The ordering physician must have experience administering TMS therapy.
criteria.source_quote: The physician will have experience in administering TMS therapy.
criteria.if_missing: Does the ordering physician have experience administering TMS therapy?

criteria.text: Treatment must be given under direct supervision of the ordering physician (physician present in the area).
criteria.source_quote: The treatment shall be given under direct supervision of this physician (physician present in the area but does not necessarily personally provide the treatment).
criteria.if_missing: Is treatment given under direct supervision of the ordering physician (present in the area)?

criteria.text: Patient must not have a seizure disorder or history of seizures (except ECT-induced or isolated febrile seizures in infancy without recurrence).
criteria.source_quote: Seizure disorder or any history of seizures (except those induced by ECT or isolated febrile seizures in infancy without subsequent treatment or recurrence)
criteria.if_missing: Does the patient have a seizure disorder or history of seizures (other than ECT-induced or isolated infantile febrile seizures)?

criteria.text: Patient must not have acute or chronic psychotic symptoms or disorders in the current depressive episode.
criteria.source_quote: Presence of acute or chronic psychotic symptoms or disorders (such as schizophrenia, schizophreniform or schizoaffective disorder) in the current depressive episode
criteria.if_missing: Does the patient have acute or chronic psychotic symptoms or disorders in the current depressive episode?

criteria.text: Patient must not have neurological conditions including epilepsy, cerebrovascular disease, dementia, increased intracranial pressure, history of repetitive/severe head trauma, or CNS tumors.
criteria.source_quote: Neurological conditions that include epilepsy, cerebrovascular disease, dementia, increased intracranial pressure, history of repetitive or severe head trauma, or primary or secondary tumors in the central nervous system
criteria.if_missing: Does the patient have any of the listed neurological conditions (epilepsy, cerebrovascular disease, dementia, increased ICP, severe head trauma history, CNS tumor)?

criteria.text: Patient must not have an implanted magnetic-sensitive medical device or other implanted metal item located ≤30 cm from the TMS coil.
criteria.source_quote: Presence of an implanted magnetic-sensitive medical device located less than or equal to 30 cm from the TMS magnetic coil or other implanted metal items including, but not limited to a cochlear implant, implanted cardiac defibrillator (ICD), pacemaker, Vagus nerve stimulator (VNS), or metal aneurysm clips or coils, staples or stents.
criteria.if_missing: Does the patient have an implanted magnetic-sensitive device or other implanted metal item within 30 cm of the TMS coil?

criteria.text: For retreatment, patient must have previously met the guidelines for initial treatment.
criteria.source_quote: Retreatment may be considered for patients who met the guidelines for initial treatment and subsequently developed a relapse of depressive symptoms
criteria.if_missing: Did the patient previously meet the guidelines for initial TMS treatment?
criteria.short: Initial treatment guidelines not previously met

criteria.text: For retreatment, patient must have subsequently developed a relapse of depressive symptoms.
criteria.source_quote: subsequently developed a relapse of depressive symptoms
criteria.if_missing: Has the patient had a relapse of depressive symptoms since prior TMS treatment?

criteria.text: For retreatment, patient must have responded to prior treatment as evidenced by greater than 50% improvement in standard rating scale measurements for depressive symptoms.
criteria.source_quote: if the patient responded to prior treatments as evidenced by a greater than 50% improvement in standard rating scale measurements for depressive symptoms
criteria.if_missing: What percent improvement in standard rating scale measurements did the patient show with prior TMS treatment?
criteria.short: Prior response ≤50% improvement or not documented

not_modeled.quote: All other uses of Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation are experimental and are not covered.
not_modeled.why: General exclusionary statement, not a specific testable criterion against a single fact; covered indications are already modeled.
